summary: Verified corner spiderweb fix on /cementerio. Two clean polygonal CornerWeb SVGs are rendered as direct children of [data-testid='cementerio-page'] at top-0 left-0 and top-0 right-0, opacity 0.45, z-index 30, pointer-events: none. Right web mirrored via scaleX(-1). No bottom webs. Card clicks open the profile modal (no blocking). Toggle OFF removes all 4 direct decorative SVGs (2 corner webs + 2 VineSide); toggle ON restores them. No console errors, no horizontal scrollbar. Regressions (vine canopy full-width, VineSide left/right, spiders, flying critters) intact.

issues: Webs are visually quite subtle at opacity 0.45 on the dark background — visible but understated. Matches spec but consider bumping to 0.55-0.6 if the user wants them more prominent.

critical_code_review_comments: Cementerio.jsx is >650 lines with multiple sub-components (DinoCard, FossilPanel, Modal, ProfileModal, ConfirmResurrect, BuyModal, TxModal, HallOfFame) — should be split into separate files for maintainability.
CornerWeb has correct pointer-events-none; good implementation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Corner web bug fix validated. Verified positioning (tl/tr corners of cementerio-page container), z-30 layering above hero, pointer-events-none preserved, halloween toggle correctly toggles webs, no regressions. Screenshot at /app/test_reports/cementerio_webs.png shows both webs visible in the top-left and top-right corners of the cemetery section.
